about: Frozen data for Get-QlBlockerClass (B7, r5). clean: the exact texts that make a whole Blockers section clean (one content line, leading markdown marks and trailing * _ stripped, compared case-sensitively). Any other section is unknown unless a line is a blocker. closedWords: a line that starts B<n> or SHARED BLOCKER and says one of these words (whole word, any case) is not read as a blocker.

derivedFrom.rule: the six texts the B7 ruling names, plus every whole-section text seen at least twice in the corpus that states only that no blocker was found (with or without 'No SHARED BLOCKER'); seen counts are passes in the corpus
